entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gábor Péter Szabó was a Hungarian footballer who played for Újpest FC, as well as representing the Hungary national football team at the 1934 FIFA World Cup. He played 11 games and scored six goals for the Hungary national team as a left winger.
